claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive_class_feature
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Precise Hunter is a permanently-active modifier with no activation, no use count, and no reset cadence. The only existing ClassFeatureMechanics family is 'activation', which requires activationCost + resource (use_count) + resetCadence. A 'passive' (or 'conditional_modifier') family is needed for always-on non-activated class features.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You have Advantage on attack rolls against the creature currently marked by your Hunter's Mark.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_advantage in ClassFeatureEffect
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The effect is Advantage on attack rolls scoped to the Hunter's Mark target. ClassFeatureEffect currently only covers GrantExtraActionEffect and HealHpEffect. A modify_roll_advantage variant (already present in MasteryEffect and v4 taxonomy) is needed in ClassFeatureEffect.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You have Advantage on attack rolls against the creature currently marked by your Hunter's Mark.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: mark-scoped attachment for class feature modifiers
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The advantage is conditional on the target being the current Hunter's Mark target. This requires a way to scope a roll modifier to 'attacks against the marked creature' — distinct from a general advantage buff and related to the mark attachment atom. No existing ClassFeatureEffect variant expresses attachment-scoped roll modification.
